PcosSkinHair.6: I-PCOS inokubangela utshintsho olubonakalayo esikhumbeni, kwiinwele zomzimba okanye kwiinwele zentloko. Ukuqonda apho zivela khona kwenza kube lula ukuzibona nokwazi ukuba zeziphi izisombululo ezinokucatshulwa.
PcosSkinHair.7: Ezi mpawu zixhaphakile, kodwa ngokwazo azifuneki kwaye azanele ukuxela ukuba une-PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.19: I-PCOS inokubandakanya ukwanda kwemveliso okanye komsebenzi we-androgens, ihomoni ezikho ngokwemvelo nakumabhinqa. Xa isiphumo sazo sinamandla ngakumbi, zinokuchaphazela imithambo yeoli, iingcambu zeenwele, nomjikelo wokukhula kweenwele.
PcosSkinHair.20: Olu setyenziswa lwehomoni yeyona nto inokuchaza ukuvela kwamaqhakuva aqhubekayo, ukukhula kweenwele okwandileyo, okanye, kwabanye abafazi, ukunciphisa kweenwele.
PcosSkinHair.22: Iimpawu ezibonakalayo azibonisi ngokuqinisekileyo ukuba i-PCOS inzima kangakanani. Omnye umfazi unokuba neempawu ezininzi ezibonakalayo, omnye abe nazo ezimbalwa okanye angabi nazo kwaphela.
PcosSkinHair.23: Amaqhakuva ahambelana notshintsho lwehomoni anokuvela okanye aqhubeke emva kwexesha lokutyhubela. Adla ngokuchaphazela isilevu, umhlathi, amadlala asezantsi, okanye ngamanye amaxesha intamo.
PcosSkinHair.24: Kwabanye abantu, amaqhakuva ayinzulu, abuhlungu kwaye ayabuya. Anokushiya iimpawu ezimnyama okanye amanxeba xa ekrokrelwa okanye xa evuvukele kakhulu.
PcosSkinHair.28: Ukuvela kwamaqhakuva ngamanye amaxesha emva kotshintsho lwehomoni
PcosSkinHair.29: Iimpawu okanye amanxeba asalayo emva kokuvela kwamaqhakuva
PcosSkinHair.30: I-Hirsutism sisitsho sokukhula kweenwele ezigculelwe kwiindawo ezingadli ukuchaphazeleka kumabhinqa. Kwimeko ye-PCOS, inokunxulumaniswa nesiphumo se-androgens kwiingcambu zeenwele.
PcosSkinHair.31: Iindawo ezidla ukuchaphazeleka zisilevu, umlomo ongasentla, isifuba, isisu, okanye umhlana. Ukuba iinwele zikhula kangakanani kwahluka kakhulu ngomntu nomntu.
PcosSkinHair.34: Iinwele ezirhabaxa ngakumbi esilevini okanye emlonyeni ongasentla
PcosSkinHair.35: Ukukhula kweenwele okunokuvela esifubeni, esiswini, okanye emhlana
PcosSkinHair.38: Ukukhula kweenwele kuxhomekeke kwiimpawu zemfuza nakwizinto zomntu ngamnye. Ukukhula kweenwele okuphawulekayo akuthethi ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba i-PCOS ikho.
PcosSkinHair.39: Abanye abafazi abane-PCOS baphawula nokuncipha kobuninzi beenwele. Ukunciphisa kunokubonakala ngakumbi encotsheni yentloko okanye ecaleni kwemigca yoqhekeko.
PcosSkinHair.40: Oku kunokukhula kancinci kancinci. Kubalulekile ukwahlula ukuphuma kweenwele okunxulumene nehomoni kwezinye izizathu ezinokubakho, ezifana nokuswela, ingxaki yethayiroyidi, amayeza athile, okanye ixesha lenkxalabo enkulu.
PcosSkinHair.42: Ukuphuma kweenwele okukhulu, okukhawulezileyo, okanye okungaqhelekanga kufanele kuhlolwe ngugqirha ukufumana isizathu.
PcosSkinHair.43: Inkqubo elula nehlala ihleli ihlala ibhetele kunokufaka iimveliso ezininzi. Injongo kukucoca, ukufumela nokukhusela isikhumba ngelixa kunqandwa nantoni na enokuqhubeka ibangela ukucaphuka.
PcosSkinHair.44: Inkqubo ethambileyo nehlala ihleli yokukhathalela isikhumba
PcosSkinHair.48: Xa iinwele zibhityile, kunokunceda ukunciphisa uxinzelelo olubuyelelayo kuzo: ubushushu obugqithisileyo, iindlela zokuluka eziqinileyo kakhulu, okanye unyango lweekhemikhali rhoqo.
PcosSkinHair.49: Ukubonana nogqirha wesikhumba kunokuba luncedo ukuba ubuninzi beenwele buqhubeka bunciphisa, ukunceda ukufumana isizathu nokuthetha ngonyango olukhoyo.
PcosSkinHair.51: Khetha iimveliso ezithambileyo kwaye ugcine ukufaka unyango oluninzi olucaphukisayo
PcosSkinHair.52: Coca isikhumba ngaphandle kokusomisa kakhulu, ekuseni nangokuhlwa ukuba kuyafuneka
PcosSkinHair.53: Sebenzisa ukukhusela ilanga xa isikhumba sibonakele
PcosSkinHair.54: Phepha ukukrokra amaqhakuva ukunciphisa iimpawu namanxeba
PcosSkinHair.55: Cela icebiso kumchwephesha ukuba iimpawu ziyaqhubeka okanye ziyabhetyebhetye
PcosSkinHair.56: Unyango lixhomekeke kwiimpawu, ubukhulu bazo, impembelelo yazo kumgangatho wobomi, nakwiinjongo zemfazi ngamnye. Kunokunceda ukusebenza kwiindawo ezininzi kunokufuna isisombululo esinye.
PcosSkinHair.58: Inkqubo efanelekileyo nesiluleko segqirha lesikhumba ukuba kuyafuneka.
PcosSkinHair.65: Kulungile ukuthetha nechwephesha lezempilo xa amaqhakuva eqhubeka okanye ebuhlungu, xa iinwele zikhula ngokukhawuleza, xa iinwele zibhityile ngokuphawulekayo, okanye xa utshintsho olu luhamba nemijikelo engaqhelekanga kakhulu.
PcosSkinHair.66: Igqirha lesikhumba linokulawula iimpawu zesikhumba neenwele. Igqirha lamabhinqa okanye elinye ichwephesha elifanelekileyo linokuhlola nemeko yehomoni nayiphi na enye imiqondiso enokubakho ye-PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.68: Ukukhula kweenwele okukhawulezileyo nokukhulu, ukuphuma kweenwele ngequbuliso, okanye utshintsho lwehomoni olungaqhelekanga kufuna isiluleko sezonyango.
PcosSkinHair.69: Ukuba namaqhakuva akuthethi ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba une-PCOS
PcosSkinHair.70: Ukukhula kweenwele okubonakalayo akunxulumananga ngaso sonke isihlandlo nehomoni kuphela
PcosSkinHair.71: I-PCOS inokuchaphazela abafazi abanalo nawuphi na umzimba
PcosSkinHair.72: Iimpawu zinokutshintsha ngokuhamba kwexesha kwaye azifani kumfazi ngamnye
PcosSkinHair.73: Iimpawu ezibonakalayo ze-PCOS zinokukudika, kodwa azichazi ubufazi bakho, ixabiso lakho, okanye ucoceko lwakho.
PcosSkinHair.75: I-PCOS inokuchaphazela isikhumba, iinwele zomzimba neenwele zentloko.
PcosSkinHair.77: Uphawu olunye alwanelanga ukuxela ukuba une-PCOS.
PcosSkinHair.79: Inkxaso yezonyango inokukunceda ukhethe indlela ekufanele.
PcosSkinHair.81: Amaqhakuva, ukukhula kweenwele okpreleyo, okanye ukuphuma kweenwele kunokuba yimpawu ze-PCOS, kodwa azingqongqo ukuba zivele. Indlela eyenzelwe wena inokukunceda ulawule iimpawu ngcono uzive ukhululekile imihla ngemihla.
PcosSkinHair.82: Eli nqaku lolwazi kuphela kwaye alithathi indawo yokubonana nogqirha, ukuxilongwa, okanye unyango olwenzelwe wena.
PcosSkinHair.83: Isikhumba, iinwele neempawu ezibonakalayo ze-PCOS — AWA

PerineumStrengthening.1:
Ukomeleza i-pelvic floor yakho
emva kokubeleka
PerineumStrengthening.6: Emva kokukhulelwa nokubeleka, i-pelvic floor idinga ixesha lokuphila. Imithambo elula, eqhelekileyo nenyuka kancinci inokukunceda ubuyisele amandla, ulawulo nokuzithemba, ngaphandle kokuzama ukukhawulezisa izinto.
PerineumStrengthening.10: Xa kufuneka uqale uhlaziyo lwe-pelvic floor
PerineumStrengthening.18: Ukomeleza i-pelvic floor yakho emva kokubeleka — AWA
PerineumStrengthening.20: I-perineum, ekwabizwa ngokuba yi-pelvic floor, liqela leemisipha eliseziko lenkqayi. Idlala indima ekulawuleni isinyi nesikhumba ibe inceda ukuxhasa iinkqubo zenkqayi.
PerineumStrengthening.21: Ngexesha lokukhulelwa, ezi misipha kufuneka zithwale ubunzima obongezelelweyo iinyanga ezininzi. Zikwabekwa phantsi koxinzelelo olukhulu ngexesha lokubeleka.
PerineumStrengthening.23: I-pelvic floor ibandakanyeka kwimisebenzi emininzi yemihla ngemihla: ukubamba umchamo nesidoda, ukulawula umoya, ukuxhasa izitho zenkqayi, nokudlala indima kwimisebenzi ethile yezesondo.
PerineumStrengthening.25: Ukomeleza kancinci nokwenziwa ngokuchanekileyo kunokunceda ukuphucula ulawulo nenkxaso ye-pelvic floor.
PerineumStrengthening.28: I-pelvic floor idlala indima ekulawuleni isinyi. Ukuyomeleza kancinci kunokunceda ukunciphisa ukuvuza komchamo okuthile.
PerineumStrengthening.31: Ezi misipha zinceda nokulawula umoya nesidoda kwaye zinegalelo ekuxhaseni izitho zenkqayi.
PerineumStrengthening.34: I-pelvic floor yenza isiseko semisipha esinceda ukuxhasa isinyi, isizalo nesisu esincinci.
PerineumStrengthening.37: Uhlaziyo olufanelekileyo lunokukunceda ufumane ukuqonda nolawulo olungcono lwale ndawo.
PerineumStrengthening.38: Kutheni ukukhulelwa nokubeleka kuyibeka phantsi koxinzelelo
PerineumStrengthening.39: Ukukhulelwa kubeka uxinzelelo olungakumbi kancinci kwi-pelvic floor. Ukubeleka ngomgudu wesibeleko kunokolula ngokukhulu imisipha nemithambo kule ndawo.
PerineumStrengthening.40: Ukuhlinzwa kokubeleka (cesarean) akuyikhuseli ngokupheleleyo i-pelvic floor: ukukhulelwa ngokwako kuhlala kuyixesha elibalulekileyo kwezi misipha.
PerineumStrengthening.41: Emva kokubeleka, kuqhelekile ke ukuba ukuphila kuthathe ixesha. Abanye abafazi abavakalelwa kuphantse kungabikho mpawu, ngelixa abanye banokuphawula ukuvuza, imvakalelo yobunzima, okanye ukuncipha kolawulo lwemisipha.
PerineumStrengthening.43: Uhlobo lokubeleka, ukuqhekeka okanye i-episiotomy, ubukho bobuhlungu, nemeko yakho jikelele emva kokubeleka zonke zinokuchaphazela ukuphila.
PerineumStrengthening.44: Xa kufuneka uqale uhlaziyo lwe-pelvic floor?
PerineumStrengthening.45: Emva kokubeleka okungenamingeni, ukuncina okuthambileyo kwe-pelvic floor kudla ngokuqalwa kwakhona kancinci. Kusabalulekile ukulungelelanisa imithambo kwimeko yakho nokucela icebiso ukuba ubunengxaki, ubuhlungu obukhulu, okanye inkqubo ethile.
PerineumStrengthening.46: Ukuba une-catheter yomchamo, ezinye iingcebiso zicebisa ukulinda de isuswe kwaye ukuchama okuqhelekileyo kuqale kwakhona ngaphambi kokuqala imithambo ye-perineum.
PerineumStrengthening.48: Ubuhlungu obukhulu, iimpawu ezibhetyebhetyayo, inxeba eliphilayo kakubi, okanye nayiphi na inkxalabo ekhethekileyo kufuna icebiso lombelekisi, igqirha, okanye ichwephesha lohlaziyo.
PerineumStrengthening.50: Ukuchonga intshukumo, cinga ngokuzama ukubamba umoya nesilumkiso sokuchama kunye. Intshukumo oyifunayo yimvakalelo yokuncina nokuphakamisa ngaphakathi.
PerineumStrengthening.51: Injongo ayikukuqinisa umzimba wakho wonke. Iimpundu, amathanga nesisu kufuneka zihlale zikhululekile kangangoko, ngelixa ukuphefumla kuqhubeka ngokuqhelekileyo.
PerineumStrengthening.61: Emva kokuncina ngakunye, vumela imisipha ikhululeke ngokupheleleyo. Uhlaziyo oluhle aluthethi ukugcina i-perineum ixinene usuku lonke.
PerineumStrengthening.63: Ekuqaleni, eyona nto ibalulekileyo kukufunda ukuchonga imisipha nokwenza intshukumo ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuhlala uqhubeka kubaluleke ngakumbi kunamandla.
PerineumStrengthening.65: Ncina i-pelvic floor ngobunono, emva koko ugcine ukuncina imizuzwana embalwa ngaphandle kokubamba umoya. Emva koko khulula ngokupheleleyo ngaphambi kokuqala kwakhona.
PerineumStrengthening.67: Xa intshukumo ifundiwe, kunokongezwa ukuncina okuncinci okukhawulezileyo. Kunceda ukuqeqesha ukukwazi kwakho ukuncina imisipha ngokukhawuleza xa uxinzelelo lwesisu lunyuka, umzekelo ngaphambi nje kokukhohlela okanye ukuthimla.

Pms.24: Ukuguquguquka kwehomoni, ngakumbi kwi-progesterone ne-estrogen, kuchaphazela ii-neurotransmitters zobuchopho (serotonin, dopamine), nto leyo enokuchaza iimpawu zeemvakalelo nezomzimba ze-PMS.
Pms.26: Ukuguquguquka kwehomoni kunokuchaphazela imood, amandla, ukulala, neemvakalelo ezithile zomzimba.
Pms.28: Ukusela amanzi anele kunceda ukunciphisa ukuqumba.
Pms.30: Khetha ukutya okuphezulu kwi-magnesium, i-omega-3, nee-vitamin B.
Pms.32: Umsebenzi womzimba ukhulula ii-endorphins kwaye unciphisa uxinzelelo.
Pms.34: Imithambo yokuphefumla, ukucamngca, ukubhala ijenali… Fumana oko kukusebenzela.
Pms.36: Ukulala okumgangatho ophezulu kuxhasa ukulingana kwehomoni.
Pms.38: Ukuba iimpawu zinkulu kakhulu kwaye zichaphazela ubomi bakho bemihla ngemihla, kunokuba yi-premenstrual dysphoric disorder (PMDD). Ungathandabuzi ukubonana nechwephesha lezempilo.
Pms.39: I-syndrome yangaphambi kwexesha lenyanga (PMS): ukuyiqonda ngcono — AWA

PostpartumPeriodReturn.1:
Ukubuya kwexesha lenyanga emva kokubeleka,
oko kunokulindelwa
PostpartumPeriodReturn.4: Emva kokubeleka, ukubuya kwexesha lakho lenyanga kunokuthatha ixesha. Ixesha lixhomekeke ekuncancisweni, phakathi kwezinye izinto, kwaye umntu ngamnye angaliva ngokwahlukileyo eli xesha.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.5: Ukubuya kwexesha lenyanga emva kokubeleka, oko kunokulindelwa — AWA
PostpartumPeriodReturn.6: 1. Kuthetha ukuthini ukubuya kwexesha lenyanga emva kokubeleka?
PostpartumPeriodReturn.7: “Ukubuya kwexesha lenyanga” kubhekisa ekubuyeni kwexesha lakho lenyanga emva kokubeleka. Umjikelo wexesha lenyanga awubuyeli ngokuzenzekelayo kwisantya sawo esiqhelekileyo kwangoko.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.9: Akukho xesha lilodwa elisebenza wonke umntu.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.11: Ixesha lixhomekeke kakhulu ekuncancisweni. Ngaphandle kokuncancisa, ixesha lakho lenyanga lidla ngokubuya malunga neeveki ezi-6 ukuya kwezi-8. Ngokuncancisa kuphela, kunokubambezeleka iinyanga ezininzi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.13: Ngokuqhelekileyo malunga neeveki ezi-6 ukuya kwezi-8.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.17: Umjikelo ubuya kancinci kancinci emva kokubeleka. Ukuncancisa kunokuchaphazela ixesha lokuvela kwakhona kwexesha lakho lenyanga.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.21: Umjikelo wexesha lenyanga umiswa okwethutyana emva kokubeleka.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.23: Umzimba uphila kancinci kancinci kwaye amanqanaba ehomoni ayatshintsha.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.25: Ukuncancisa kunokubambezela ukubuya kwexesha lakho lenyanga, kodwa isiphumo sako sihluka ngomntu nomntu.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.27: Ixesha lakho lokuqala lenyanga lingabuya emva kweeveki ezimbalwa okanye iinyanga ezininzi.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.29: Imijikelo inokungaqhelekanga ngaphambi kokubuyela kancinci kwisantya sayo esiqhelekileyo.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.30: Akukho xesha elifanayo wonke umntu. Ixesha lokubuya kwexesha lakho lenyanga linokwahluka ngomntu nomntu, ngakumbi ngokuxhomekeke ekuncancisweni.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.32: Xa ixesha lakho lenyanga libuya, imijikelo yokuqala inokwahluka kuleyo yangaphambi kokukhulelwa. Ngakumbi, inokungaqhelekanga ekuqaleni.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.34: Umjikelo unokuthatha ixesha ukuba ubuyele kwisantya esiqhelekileyo.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.36: Ukuhamba kunokwahluka kokuthe wakubona ngaphambi kokukhulelwa.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.38: Ukulandelela okulula kukunceda ukubona ngcono indlela umjikelo wakho otshintsha ngayo ngokuhamba kwexesha.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.40: Phawula usuku lokuqala lexesha lakho lenyanga.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.42: Khangela kancinci kancinci ixesha eliphakathi kwemijikelo.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.44: Khangela nje nawaphi na utshintsho xa kuthelekiswa nokuqhelekileyo kuwe.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.46: Ukuba kukho into ebonakala ingaqhelekanga, iqhubeka, okanye ikukhathazayo, cela icebiso kuchwephesha lezempilo.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.52: Ukubuya kwexesha lenyanga emva kokubeleka kubhekisa ekubuyeni kwexesha lakho lenyanga emva kokubeleka.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.53: Ukuncancisa kunokubambezela ukubuya kwexesha lakho lenyanga.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.55: Ukuphawula imihla kunokukunceda ulandelele indlela umjikelo wakho otshintsha ngayo.
PostpartumPeriodReturn.56: Umxholo wolwazi. Amaxesha anokwahluka ngokweemeko nganye kwaye awathathi ndawo yeengcebiso zezonyango.
